name: Azrad
source:
The former master of [url=/c932]Al Azif[/url], he is the pilot of the Deus Machina Aeon. A young Arabian gentleman obsessed with revenge. 

It is possible his name is derived from H.P. Lovecraft's character Abdul Alhazred, who is credited for authoring the Kitab al-Azif, better known as the Necronomicon. 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Demonbane_characters#Characters_that_appear_in_other_media]Wikipedia[/url].]

[spoiler]In truth, he is one of the dream-like beings that was born in the nightmare world of [url=https://vndb.org/c12696]Another Blood[/url]. As the real Azrad have sacrificed himself to summon Demonbane in the prequel Light Novel Kishin Taidou.[/spoiler]

"---Believe in Demonbane. Because that is the Deus Machina for humanity."

[Translated from the [url=http://www.demonbane.com/special/]Demonbane Official Site[/url]]
